items.headline: WHO verifies Thailand has eliminated rubella as a public health problem
items.summary: The World Health Organization confirmed that Thailand has eliminated rubella, a leading vaccine preventable cause of birth defects, making it the seventh country in the South East Asia region to reach this milestone. Health officials say sustained immunization coverage will be needed to keep new cases from being imported.
items.why_it_matters: Rubella elimination means far fewer babies born with lifelong birth defects from congenital rubella syndrome.
